csv_scope_of_work: The City of Palmdale seeks a qualified consultant to provide professional civil and traffic engineering design services, as well as public outreach services for PN 943, 10th Street West from Rancho Vista Blvd to Avenue M-8, (Project). The Project is located along 10th Street West from Rancho Vista Blvd to Avenue M-8, a major arterial road and designated Truck Route. The Project proposes to reconstruct the roadway pavement and install ADA concrete sidewalks. The proposed scopes include design services for City of Palmdale coordination and permitting, public notification, traffic control per the WATCH Manual, drainage study, pavement deflection and structural spatial inventory of utility infrastructure at the surface, complete plans specifications, and construction costs
csv_disciplines_requested: Civil Engineering, Geotechnical Engineering, Planning/Master Planning, Hydrology/Hydraulics, Traffic Design Engineering
